messages.--profile 仅用于 OpenClaw；其他宿主沿用当前环境。: --profile applies only to OpenClaw; other hosts use the current environment.
messages.agent 传 --host codex|hermes|openclaw，不让用: The agent should pass --host codex|hermes|openclaw without asking the user to guess.
messages.status 内容格式无效。: The status content has an invalid format.
messages.status 文本无法解析。: The status text could not be parsed.
messages.status 结构缺失或不同表示相互冲突。: The status structure is missing or its representations conflict.
messages.status 缺少验证所需字段。: Status lacks fields required for verification.
messages.下载文件校验不一致，已删除暂存文件，未执行。: The downloaded file failed hash verification; the staging file was removed and not executed.
messages.下载未完成；保留锁定发布信息以便恢复。: The download did not finish; pinned release information was kept for recovery.
messages.下载重定向不属于已支持的官方发布主机。: The download redirect is outside supported official release hosts.
messages.中断安装留下的程序不匹配，未覆盖。: The binary left by an interrupted installation does not match; it was not overwritten.
messages.使用宿主核实原连接。: Verify the original connection through the host.
messages.使用宿主核实原连接；不替换、不重启、不切换环境。: Verify the original connection through the host; do not replace, restart, or switch environments.
messages.先定位原安装，不删除现有文件。: Locate the original installation first; do not delete existing files.
messages.兼容清单缺失或格式错误，未下载程序。: The compatibility manifest is missing or invalid; the binary was not downloaded.
messages.协议返回超出验证上限。: The protocol response exceeds the verification limit.
messages.发布文件超过支持的大小。: The release asset exceeds the supported size.
messages.发现已有服务或钱包数据，暂不按首次安装处理。: An existing service or wallet data was found; this was not treated as a first install.
messages.受管程序尚未安装。: The managed binary is not installed.
messages.另一个安装或服务进程正在使用此实例。: Another installer or service process is using this instance.
messages.同名宿主配置指向其他目标，未覆盖。: The host configuration name points to another target; it was not overwritten.
messages.命令参数无效；使用 --help 查看接口。: Invalid command arguments; use --help to inspect the interface.
messages.复用原连接或明确选择另一个名称。: Reuse the original connection or explicitly choose another name.
messages.复用已有实例；稍后重新检查，不另起服务。: Reuse the existing instance; inspect again later without starting another service.
messages.安装目录有未识别内容，暂不覆盖。: The installation directory contains unrecognized content; it was not overwritten.
messages.安装记录字段不一致；不执行其中的命令。: Installation record fields disagree; its command was not executed.
messages.安装记录无法读取；未将它当作未安装。: The installation record cannot be read; it was not treated as a fresh install.
messages.官方发布信息暂时无法读取。: Official release information is temporarily unavailable.
messages.宿主命令失败，需回读配置确认是否已生效。: The host command failed; read back configuration to determine whether it took effect.
messages.宿主命令无法执行或超时，需回读配置确认结果。: The host command could not run or timed out; read back configuration to determine the result.
messages.宿主版本无法确定，暂不安装。: The host version could not be established; installation was not started.
messages.宿主配置在准备过程中变化，未执行写入。: Host configuration changed during preparation; no write was performed.
messages.宿主配置路径必须是绝对路径。: The host configuration path must be absolute.
messages.工具列表分页重复或无效。: Tool-list pagination repeated or was invalid.
messages.工具列表超过验证上限。: The tool list exceeds the verification limit.
messages.已有受管连接但缺少有效安装记录，暂不新装。: A managed connection exists without a valid installation record; a new installation was not started.
messages.已有外部连接请用宿主验证；否则先执行 ensure。: Verify an existing external connection through the host; otherwise run ensure first.
messages.已有安装使用不同环境；没有切换。: The existing installation uses a different environment; it was not switched.
messages.当前 CLI 缺少所需能力，不改配置或自动升级宿主。: The current CLI lacks required capabilities; configuration and host version were not changed.
messages.安装版本与随包契约基线不一致，未下载或注册程序。: The installation version differs from the packaged contract baseline; no binary was downloaded or registered.
messages.指定连接不存在；未改为默认新装。: The specified connection does not exist; this was not converted into a default new install.
messages.按锁定的原发布信息继续 ensure。: Continue ensure using the pinned original release information.
messages.操作中断或本地读写失败；需核实当前状态后继续。: The operation was interrupted or local I/O failed; verify the current state before continuing.
messages.无法启动受管服务。: The managed service could not start.
messages.无法核实已有本机服务，暂不新装。: An existing local service could not be verified; a new installation was not started.
messages.无法识别宿主配置，未将它当作没有连接。: The host configuration could not be interpreted; it was not treated as having no connection.
messages.无法识别当前 OpenClaw profile。: The current OpenClaw profile could not be identified.
messages.无法识别服务工具列表。: The service tool list could not be interpreted.
messages.服务 status 返回工具错误。: Service status returned a tool error.
messages.服务 stdout 含非 MCP JSON 数据。: Service stdout contains non-MCP JSON data.
messages.服务在协议验证完成前退出。: The service exited before protocol verification completed.
messages.服务已退出，无法完成协议验证。: The service exited before protocol verification could complete.
messages.服务未协商受支持协议或工具能力。: The service did not negotiate a supported protocol or tool capability.
messages.服务缺少本次任务所需工具；没有自动升级。: The service lacks a tool required for this task; it was not upgraded automatically.
messages.服务返回无效协议消息。: The service returned an invalid protocol message.
messages.服务返回错误或不匹配的响应。: The service returned an error or a mismatched response.
messages.未取得完整且可信的稳定版发布信息；未开始替换。: Complete, trusted stable release information was not obtained; replacement did not start.
messages.未找到当前宿主 CLI；不会自动安装或升级宿主。: The current host CLI was not found; the host will not be installed or upgraded automatically.
messages.核实原因后继续；不要重复钱包写操作。: Verify the cause before continuing; do not repeat wallet writes.
messages.没有受管安装可探测。: There is no managed installation to probe.
messages.没有当前 CPU 的已支持发布文件。: No supported release asset matches this CPU.
messages.沿用已有环境，或另行明确要求切换环境。: Keep the existing environment, or explicitly request a separate environment change.
messages.独立探测通过；仍须当前宿主加载工具并验证 status，才可继续钱包业务。: The isolated probe passed; the current host must still load tools and verify status before wallet work continues.
messages.由 agent 定位并连接原实例；无法唯一确定时只澄清目标。: The agent should locate and connect the original instance, clarifying the target only if it cannot be uniquely identified.
messages.由 agent 根据任务定位连接，仍有歧义时请用户选择。: The agent should identify the task's connection and ask the user only if ambiguity remains.
messages.由宿主加载已有服务并验证 status。: Have the host load the existing service and verify status.
messages.确认原连接名称或恢复原配置。: Confirm the original connection name or restore its configuration.
messages.程序缺失或散列与安装记录不符；不自动覆盖或执行。: The binary is missing or its hash differs from the installation record; it was not overwritten or executed.
messages.让当前宿主刷新工具；不能热加载时重新连接/打开会话，然后核对 status 和所: Refresh tools in the current host; if hot loading is unavailable, reconnect or open a session, then verify status and required tools.
messages.询问：实际使用还是测试体验？: Ask: Is this for real use or for testing?
messages.核实原安装记录与当前 skill 版本；不要覆盖记录或静默切换版本。: Check the original installation record and current skill version; do not overwrite the record or silently switch versions.
messages.运行版本、环境或传输方式与安装记录不一致。: The running version, environment, or transport differs from the installation record.
messages.连接名称只能包含字母、数字、下划线和连字符。: Connection names may contain only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.
messages.通过宿主复用并核实原连接，不另行安装或启动。: Reuse and verify the original connection through the host; do not install or start another service.
messages.配置回读不符合预期；保留备份，未自动覆盖回滚。: Configuration readback differs from expectations; the backup was retained and no overwrite rollback was attempted.
messages.需要 agent 指定当前宿主。: The agent must specify the current host.
messages.首次安装用途尚未明确。: The purpose of the first installation is not yet clear.
messages.首次用途不明时问实际使用还是测试体验，再执行 ensure。: If the purpose is unknown, ask whether this is for real use or testing before running ensure.
messages.首版自动管理仅支持 macOS/Linux。: Initial automatic management supports macOS/Linux only.
